snippet.title: SIP FISHER RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT
snippet.description:
It’s finally happening, everybody! Sip Fisher is going to be released! We are excited to announce that the full game will be available to purchase on:

August 27th! 

Until then, thank you for being part of our little community, and happy sip fishing, everyone!
